decisions.reason: The supplier def-smooth-embedding defines embeddings and proves no graph-neighbourhood theorem. This was a misleading reference label, not a premise in the proof-free handlebody/Heegaard definition: the Definition itself constructs handlebodies by attaching 1-handles and makes no graph-neighbourhood assertion. Replaced only the reference label with smooth embeddings of attaching disks and handlebodies; the complete Definition is byte-identical. No consumer propagation is triggered.

The supplier Statement promises a diffeomorphism and a marked two-handle trace but does not explicitly promise an orientation-preserving closed output comparison. F1 and steps 1.1/3.1 imported that extra conclusion without checking its sign. Restated the literal supplier interface and repaired the proof: if the supplied comparison reverses orientation, reflect S3 and negate every framing. The peripheral classes transform as mu prime = -r_*mu and lambda prime = r_*lambda; reflection on the exterior and (z,w) -> (z, conjugate(w)) on each solid torus give a reversing comparison of the filled manifolds. Composing the two reversing maps preserves orientation. The integer-slope proof and empty case remain valid; the Statement is unchanged.

F1 referred indirectly to the peripheral-homology theorem through the surgery definition. That theorem really does establish H1(E_X;Z)=Z[mu_X] with the positive meridian and preferred-longitude basis, so the mathematical claim is available and this is a nonfatal citation defect rather than a false homology assertion. Added that existing theorem as direct dependency and F3, and sphere homology as direct dependency and F4 for the bounding-chain argument. Step 1.1 now explains why intersection computes the meridian coefficient before deriving symmetry. Checked the geometric crossing slides, splitting, descending unknotting, Hopf-core isotopy and both parity deletions; signed auxiliary parallels do not reorient the stationary component. The full framing and original L are retained. The Statement is unchanged.
